d:
A gold mining season takes a dangerous turn when a rogue gunman opens fire on Todd Hoffman's crew, forcing them to flee the mine! Meanwhile, Parker Schnabel's bulldozers struggle against frozen ground, bringing his operation to a halt. And Tony Beets begins dismantling his massive 500-ton dredge. With danger, machinery troubles and major setbacks hitting the crews, this mining season is proving tougher than expected!
Watch Gold Rush, Season 8, Episode 2, on Discovery Channel India.
